Moderna, Inc. | Pharmacovigilance Department

Case Number: US-MODERNA-2026-501451

MedDRA PT: Injection Site Cellulitis
Product: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax)
Lot Number: LOT-22513
Country: United States
1. Patient Information
Age: 61 years
Sex: Female
Weight: 78 kg
Medical History: Seasonal allergies
2. Drug Information
Drug Name: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax)
Indication: Prevention of COVID-19
Dose: 100 mcg / 0.5 mL
Route: Intramuscular
Dose Number: Dose 2
Date of Administration: 30 July 2026
3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 26-year-old female received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 29 November 2025. Approximately 10 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Injection Site Cellulitis. The patient sought medical attention and was managed outpatient. The outcome was recovering. The reporter considers the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
4. Causality Assessment
